caseStudies.shortDesc: A comprehensive retail bookstore billing ecosystem designed to streamline daily operations. caseStudies.title: Fast Video Upload System
caseStudies.shortDesc: Engineered a high-performance video processing pipeline to handle large-scale media uploads. By transitioning from server-side processing to AWS Presigned URLs and asynchronous FFmpeg compression, we eliminated backend bottlenecks, reduced server load, and achieved superior upload stability for 2GB+ files.

caseStudies.role: System Architect, MCP Implementation Lead, AI Integration & Secure Payment Designer
